title: Proof Plan for Main Supercuspidal Theorem
body_html:
Proof Plan for Main Supercuspidal Theorem

  1. Forward direction: construct \(\Sigma'=\#_{V,T'}(\Sigma)\) and the vector \(w\) attached to the block construction.
  2. Proposition 8.1 gives multiplicity one for the product \(K\)-type in the oscillator model, so the theta lift contains the compactly induced representation attached to \(\Sigma'\).
  3. First-occurrence and irreducibility identify the full theta lift with \(\widetilde\pi_{\widetilde\Sigma'}\).
  4. Converse direction: start with supercuspidal \(\widetilde\pi\) and supercuspidal theta lift \(\widetilde\pi'\).
  5. Use covering-data exhaustion to write \(\widetilde\pi\) by a covering datum.
  6. Apply Proposition 9.1 to produce equivalent source data and a target lifted \(K\)-type datum.
  7. Use supercuspidality of the target and Kim-Hakim-Murnaghan equivalence to identify the target representation with the datum produced by \(\#_{V,T'}\).
